sentence: A two-round knockout vote that narrows four options to one winner, with everyone voting in each match and the host closing it.
use_when: The group needs to pick one of four places or options by head-to-head votes

A plain poll feels too loose and a bracket would settle it faster
One person should call the end of each round
dont_use_when: The choice has more or fewer than four options
Votes should be ranked or scored instead of head-to-head
Everyone needs to vote on a single question with no rounds
The group needs to split a bill or schedule a time
